The relevant weekly workout plan is identified; I now need its exact content and must inspect all pages before selecting a playlist.

```python
workout_note_meta = [note for note in workout_notes if note['title'] == 'Weekly Workout Plan'][0]
workout_note_content = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    content_page = apis.simple_note.show_note(
        access_token=simple_note_access_token,
        note_id=workout_note_meta['note_id'],
        page_index=page_index,
        page_limit=20
    )
    if not content_page:
        break
    workout_note_content.extend(content_page)
    page_index += 1
workout_plan = '\n'.join(workout_note_content)
print(workout_plan)
```
